description: Open car-wash time slots near a place on a given day: for each centre, its slots with remaining capacity and expected busyness. A slot label such as "09:00 - 11:00" is a 2-hour window whose start is the arrival time. A concrete place (an arrondissement or a town) resolves better than a vague area such as « Paris ouest »; resolvedLocation reports how the place was understood.

location.description: City, district, postal code or centre name, e.g. "Paris 16", "Levallois" or "75017"

serviceType.description: Filter: fixed (on-site), mobile, or home service
